findings.issue: نسلك means your descendants/progeny, which inverts the generational direction: the Harbinger belongs to the brood, he does not father it. brood is also already rendered الحَضْنة in the frozen glossary (Broodseeker = طالبة الحَضْنة).

findings.source_en: (excited gasp) Who is it at such an hour?
findings.ar: (تلهث بحماس) مَن يكون في هذه الساعة؟
findings.issue: تلهث means pants / breathes heavily, not the sharp intake of breath a gasp denotes. The corpus already uses شهق for a modified gasp ((gasps in shock) = (تشهق مصدومة) / (يشهق مصدومًا)); this is the same defect flagged on (gasps) in chunk 060.
findings.suggested_ar: (تشهق بحماس) مَن يكون في هذه الساعة؟
